verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduling, such as scheduled reports or queries, is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no first-party way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. Alerts on log patterns are a related feature, and service accounts for automation scripts are a building block for external tools rather than a built-in scheduler, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
